rows.label: tlk45350171_03_msg0001
rows.name:
There's no point staying
here in Acedia. Not now
that Fan-sama is gone.

rows.label: tlk45350171_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I'll leave the work to my companions
and head back to Superbia ahead of
them.

rows.label: tlk45350171_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Ah, Fan-sama... Even if I go to the
cathedral, I won't see you anymore...
